description: This line plot illustrates the "Average Repetition Rate" across various "Relation Category" indices for three different configurations and their respective averages. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate," also employs a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six lines. The first configuration, "w/o DPO obo," is represented by a solid blue line with dot markers; it exhibits high volatility, starting at approximately 0.25 at x=0, reaching notable peaks of roughly 0.60 at x=1 and 0.62 at x=31, and ending at approximately 0.05 at x=64. The second configuration, "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," is shown as a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at roughly 0.13 at x=0, fluctuates significantly with peaks at approximately 0.58 at x=31 and 0.46 at x=47, and concludes at roughly 0.15 at x=64. The third configuration, "DPO," is depicted by a solid green line with star markers; it starts at approximately 0.16 at x=0, reaches its highest peak of roughly 0.28 at x=1, drops to a low of approximately 0.01 at x=9, and ends at roughly 0.07 at x=64. Additionally, three horizontal dashed lines without markers represent the averages for each configuration across the entire x-axis range: a blue dashed line for the "Average of w/o DPO obo" remains constant at 0.163, an orange dashed line for the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" remains constant at 0.227, and a green dashed line for the "Average of DPO" remains constant at 0.117.
